headline: Impact of the Dominican milling industry on employment and the economy
summary: A study presented at the ALIM 2026 Latin American wheat milling assembly in Punta Cana put Dominican milling sales at 31,535 million pesos in 2025, about $500 million. It also assessed the sector's employment impact.
why: Flour milling turns imported and domestic wheat into a staple food input, so its sales and employment reflect the health of the food supply chain in the Dominican Republic.
original_headline: Impacto de la industria molinera dominicana en el empleo y la economía
